limitations: Continuous UTC observation only; gaps, closures, offsets, DST, leap seconds and subsecond timestamps are unsupported.
Rates use training count / observed exposure only. Daily bins and diagnostic width are manually predefined.
Conservative 95% Poisson Chernoff intervals quantify parameter uncertainty under independent Poisson counts, not future count variability. Per-bin intervals are marginal, not simultaneous.
Manual model selection. Holdout is validation/model-selection data; repeated inspection is not untouched independent final-test evidence.
Poisson likelihood/deviance describe count-model assumptions. A good total count prediction does not establish a good temporal pattern.
Existing simulation arrivals are periodic or uniform interarrival. Periodic conversion requires explicit approximation acceptance and does not reproduce Poisson variability.
Arrival records do not identify service durations. Source service and resource settings are preserved during conversion.
Zero expected count with positive observations has infinite Poisson deviance and negative-infinite likelihood; exported null with explicit unavailable status.

title: Demand model diagnostics
warnings: Fixed-parameter simulation checks condition on estimated rates; they do not include parameter or model uncertainty.
Training reference checks are descriptive: synthetic samples are not refitted. No calibrated training goodness-of-fit p-value is claimed.
Tail ranks use (1 + inclusive ties)/(replications + 1). Finite Monte Carlo resolution and multiplicity preclude proof of model adequacy.
Lag-one correlation uses at least eight fully observed adjacent pairs and is descriptive; it does not diagnose individual-arrival clustering.
Process-only intervals condition on frozen fitted rates. Parameter-aware envelopes allocate half the error budget to simultaneous Chernoff rate bounds and half to future process tails.
Parameter-aware coverage assumes independent Poisson training counts and an unchanged future intensity profile. Model misspecification is not included.
Validation bins are disjoint. Marginal interval coverage is not simultaneous coverage or an untouched independent final-test guarantee.
Synthetic observations use generator 2 at 1 Hz on integer UTC seconds, only inside observed [start,end) pieces. Windows/MSVC bitwise support is unchanged.
Settings asserted predefined by the requester; the software cannot verify they preceded observation inspection. Repeated holdout use remains untracked.
